281613868.description: This lot includes a variety of natural specimens: a fossilized coral with honeycomb texture, several mica/muscovite schist pieces with pearlescent sheen, a fossiliferous limestone chunk, a banded quartz/agate crystalline mineral, a small raw amethyst crystal point, an orange/tan mineral nodule, a clear selenite crystal with striated surface, and two small stone points. The projectile points are displayed in clear round specimen cases with cotton padding. All specimens are raw, unpolished, and in used or collected condition. Suitable for collectors of rocks, minerals, fossils, and lithic artifacts.
